numbering_note: 234 = this protocol; 235 = analysis output; 236 = optional canary reachability control; 237 = zero-call cached preview (already computed from artifacts 081/088; not part of the frozen analysis). Renumber before freezing if already used in the workspace.
question: Does the 43/46 generation-failure result survive parser-independent parsing and a blind human audit of rejected candidates, and can real selectors use the support that additional restarts add?

hypotheses.H1_parser_false_negatives: Among P0-rejected candidate texts, the share whose human canonical plan is executor-valid is near zero.
hypotheses.H2_support_is_usable: Across C1..C5, executable support grows and the oracle-minus-selector gap shows whether real selectors can use it.
hypotheses.H3_classification_stability: P1, P2 and the human census reclassify few of the 43 P0 generation-failure runs.

universes.U1_headroom_slots: The 1,152 recorded slots (72 runs x 16) of the four Table-3 original/control cohorts; the 46 P0-failed runs are the census frame.
universes.U2_pool_slots: All slots of the 20-task Qwen nested-pool study (anchor + 5 stochastic trajectories x 16 slots), used for H2 and selector replay.
universes.fixed: Candidate texts, runs, pools and P0 outcomes are reused unchanged; nothing is regenerated. The round-candidate-only pool is primary; final-inclusive is a sensitivity analysis.

parsers.P0: The current strict parser, canonicalizer and executor, unchanged.
parsers.P1: Format-robust wrapper around P0 (repro/candidate_parsers.p1_normalize): removes Markdown code fences, normalizes whitespace, line endings and Unicode punctuation, re-serializes valid JSON with sorted keys, and lower-cases and trims string items of a JSON string array. It never infers missing fields, rewrites or adds actions, interprets prose, consults references, or calls an LLM.
parsers.P2: Independent parser (repro/candidate_parsers.p2_parse), written without access to P0 code: accepts IMPOSSIBLE or exactly one distinct JSON array of item identifiers ([a-z0-9_]+ after lower-casing and removing a 'minecraft:' namespace); several distinct arrays are rejected as ambiguous. Canonical plans go to the same executor. It records a failure reason for every rejection and never sees outcomes or references.

audit.primary_census: Every unique (run, text) P0-rejected candidate in the 46 P0-failed runs (at most 495 unique texts; 604 slots).
audit.secondary_sample: A stratified sample of P0-rejected unique texts from non-failed runs (up to 60 per cohort where available) plus 60 P0-accepted texts as positive controls, all shuffled into the census.
audit.annotators: Annotator A labels every audit item. Annotator B independently labels a seeded 30% of census items and all secondary and control items. Disagreements on intent class or on whether a plan is given go to a third adjudicator.
audit.mandatory_double_review: Any item that either annotator labels A2 or A3 is labelled by both annotators and adjudicated.
audit.blinding: Annotators see an opaque audit id, the candidate text, the public answer schema and the P0/P1/P2 parse outputs and reasons. They do not see cohort, model, run, run outcome, the 43/46 classification, or references. The id-to-slot key stays with a non-annotating author until labels are final.

intent.A1: action intent with critical information missing
intent.A2: complete action intent convertible to canonical actions
intent.A3: explicit executable plan violating only parser format

format_failure.F6: multi-step plan form the parser cannot process

labels.human_plan: For A2/A3 only: the canonical plan the annotator reads from the text, without adding steps; executed by the executor (E2) and checked offline against the reference (E3).

execution_status.E0: no canonical plan (A0/A1, or no parseable human plan)
execution_status.note: Derived from the human plan by the executor and the offline reference check; annotators never assign E labels or see references.

audit.agreement: Cohen's kappa for intent (4 classes) and for plan-given (binary) on the double-labelled items.

selectors.B0_recorded: Highest recorded runtime score (current heuristic, with runtime ties broken by a seeded draw), if per-slot scores are in the traces.
selectors.B1_random: Uniform over the pool; exact expectation plus 1,000 seeded replays.
selectors.B3_success_only: Recorded environment success flag; if only executor validity is available it is labelled an offline diagnostic, not a deployable selector.
selectors.B4_composite: 0.85*min(1,|y|/800)+0.15*success, recomputed from text length and the recorded success flag.
selectors.B5_judge: Judge-only and heuristic-plus-judge, if judge scores are recorded; report calls and tokens.
selectors.B6_oracle: Executor-validity upper bound, reference exactness as an outcome-aware tie-break; never a baseline.

pool: token-matched if per-trajectory tokens are recorded
ablations.endpoint: For every score-ablation cell, report the paired contrast under executable validity, reference exactness, and both.

statistics.unit: Tasks and runs are the inferential units. Slot- and text-level intervals are descriptive.
statistics.q_fn: Share of audited P0-rejected texts whose adjudicated human plan is executor-valid: unweighted exact Clopper-Pearson interval and a design-weighted estimate with a run-clustered stratified bootstrap; the decision uses the larger upper bound.
statistics.selector_contrasts: Paired task-level bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 234) against B4 and B1; exact McNemar for binary task outcomes.

decision_rules.tier_A_robust: The human census reclassifies at most 2 of the 43 P0 generation-failure runs, P1 and P2 each reclassify at most 2, and the one-sided 95% upper bound of q_FN is at most 0.05. Keep the generation-support wording and report the updated count.
decision_rules.tier_B_qualified: 3 to 9 runs are reclassified under the census or any parser variant. Report that most failures are generation failures but the parser accounts for k runs; name the formats responsible.
decision_rules.tier_C_weakened: 10 or more runs are reclassified. Rename the bottleneck 'parser- and protocol-mediated candidate support' throughout the title, abstract and conclusion.
decision_rules.cohort_flag: If one cohort's q_FN upper bound exceeds twice the pooled upper bound, report it as provider-specific and stratify the claim.
decision_rules.selector_claim: A selector improvement is claimed only if its paired task-level 95% interval excludes zero on the round-only pool, without extra tokens or final-inclusive hindsight.
decision_rules.threshold_note: The 2-run, 10-run and 5% cut-offs are internal reporting thresholds fixed before inspection, not general standards.

outputs.audit_packet: research/artifacts/candidate-support-audit-packet-234/ (blinded CSVs plus a private key file excluded from any public package)
outputs.figures: repro/make_candidate_support_figures.py: funnel, run-reclassification matrix, selector versus support, selector cost table

already_known: Executable validity and reference exactness give identical paired contrasts in both cached non-degenerate length-removal cohorts (DeepSeek +0.167, 2/0 discordant; Qwen -0.050, 2/3).
On the Qwen nested pools a uniformly random final answer scores 0.50-0.54 while the offline oracle rises 0.60-0.80; a random stochastic slot scores about 0.41.

The 46 P0-failed runs hold 604 rejected slots and at most 495 unique texts; 43 generation failures average 13.6 rejected slots, so a 1% per-slot false-negative rate would be expected to move about 5 runs under independence.
cached_preview_237.consequence_for_design: A slot sample bounding q_FN at 5% cannot protect the run-level 43/46 count, so the primary unit is a census of unique rejected texts in the failed runs and the decision is taken on run reclassifications.

keep: P0/P1/P2 over all U1 and U2 slots
census of every unique P0-rejected text in the 43 P0 generation-failure runs
30% second-annotator overlap plus double review of every A2/A3
dual endpoints for every score-ablation cell
B1 random, B4 composite and B6 oracle on the round-only pools
drop_if_needed: secondary sample from non-failed runs (then q_FN describes failed runs only)
B0, B2, B3, B5 if per-candidate scores are not in the traces
minimum_viable.never_drop: the census and the frozen decision rules
